component.name: MintSpirit font families
component.summary: The MintSpirit and MintSpiritNo2 families of fonts

description.p: The package provides the MintSpirit and MintSpiritNo2 families of fonts, designed by Hirwen Harendal. MintSpirit was originally designed for use as a system font on a Linux Mint system. The No. 2 variant provides more conventional shapes for some glyphs.
